disposition_reason: Tables II-III print per-phase and mean concentrations of six metals in seven vegetables from Kawran Bazar, Dhaka, on a dry-weight basis.

study.design: Market survey in four phases with health risk assessment
study.origin: Supply regions named for Kawran Bazar: Narsingdi, Mymensingh, Kishoreganj, Rajshahi, Jessore (not traced per sample)

study.period_text: Four sampling phases: 8 Aug, 22 Aug, 5 Sep and 30 Sep 2009
study.method: HNO3/HClO4 hot-plate digestion of 250 mg; AAS
study.qa: No CRM, recovery or blank data reported
